name: Indicio
description: Indicio is a decentralised identity and verifiable credentials company that offers a network and tooling for issuing, holding, and verifying self-sovereign identity (SSI) credentials built on the Hyperledger Aries/Indy stack. It is primarily an infrastructure product rather than a benchmark, but is referenced in AI/ML trust and identity evaluation contexts.
reputation: Recognised provider of enterprise SSI infrastructure; not a standard ML benchmark.
notes: Commercial product focused on verifiable credentials and decentralised identity; no standard quantitative benchmark exists for LLM evaluation.
